conditions: Use only the expressly described AI Reseller Program / white-label path; public program pages say reseller agreements put permitted products and rates in writing and quote wholesale rates by expected volume.
Obtain and review the current written reseller agreement, plan/terms precedence, brand, markets/currencies, permitted customer use, billing and settlement scope before any route is eligible.

Exclude Token Plans as the resale basis: Token Plan Terms §Fair use prohibits reselling/sublicensing/sharing plan credit or plan API keys outside the organization and offering plan access as one's own service.
Do not treat ordinary PAYG as resale approval; Terms prohibit resale designed to obscure responsibility for traffic. Reconcile this standard term with a specific reseller agreement.
For each model, identify the actual third-party serving provider, publisher/model license and provider terms. Inferray says models are third-party-operated and terms/policies also apply.
Obtain written wholesale rates and service/capacity commitments if required; public PAYG or Token Plan rates are not reseller rates, customer prices, or Vrooli approvals.
plan_rules.clause: AI Reseller Program and White Label pages; Terms §§Pay-as-you-go credits and payment, Acceptable use, Model providers, Availability; Token Plan Terms §Fair use of a plan
plan_rules.reason: Inferray publicly describes own-brand resale, custom packages, and negotiated wholesale rates; its FAQ says the reseller agreement defines what may be sold and at what rates. This is a conditional program candidate, not an activated account, agreement, model entitlement, or approved price.

research.model_reason: Inferray discloses third-party model operators and upstream terms; its catalog does not prove the actual provider serving a route or model-specific downstream rights.
